system.description:
An engineered suit provides you with your powers, and may even be important to keeping you alive.

Powers

Assign one die to the power @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.mbWy2aKC05gxmL8C]{Power Suit}.

Assign the rest of the dice you rolled at the end of the background step to the following powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.QD7BBCX8C7mnA1FJ]{Awareness}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.ljOm3BJL43WZbbJG]{Cold}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.GTlpRqwtk6QMb9Hi]{Elasticity}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.e1RQaEZ4KGQjjmO1]{Electricity}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.vn8X6ydhErIvOUHW]{Fire}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.DEqpcIHX8qEVJeag]{Lightning Calculator}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.tAFBYH96UfVO71Lb]{Nuclear}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.g16MUwFTT08IfvEm]{Part Detachment}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• Select from Athletic powers category

• Select from Mobility powers category

Abilities

Gain two of these Yellow abilities, each using a different power:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.NLHMcOM0XxyS8T88]{Energy Converter}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.B7Q0Bl2AMqMm5yaL]{Explosive Attack}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.HYRijTPayIxPYpXu]{Onboard Upgrade}

Gain one of these Green abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.ChxEWKdmnucs7IuV]{Damage Reduction}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.GP0GwTv3wFGyMXuG]{Diagnostic Subroutine}
Archetype

Roll d10, d6, d6 for archetype selection.
